reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: Kazakhstan II - Bank CenterCredit - Loan III

description.narrative: The provision of a 3-year senior loan in the amount of up to US$ 30 million in KZT equivalent to Bank CenterCredit JSC ("BCC") under the EBRD Green Economy Financing Facility Kazakhstan II ("GEFF II", OpId 53502) (the "Project"). The financing will be used for on-lending to eligible private sector sub-borrowers in Kazakhstan for the Green Economy Transition (GET) investments. The Project will allow BCC to support local currency lending to eligible private sector sub-borrowers for investments in climate change mitigation and adaptation technologies. The aim of the Project is to i) scale up FI-intermediated green lending; and ii) further improve BCC' skills in identifying and assessing a wide range of green investment opportunities.
